title: The Five-Step Process, Step 4: Cheerful Submission and Designing a Plan
summary: Drawing from the story of Alma's people in the Book of Mormon, President Hughes emphasizes the value of learning to endure trials by submitting cheerfully and patiently to the Lord's will. He introduces Step 4 of the five-step process: designing a plan to remove root causes. This involves replaying past actions like a game film, visualizing effective paths through a timeline script, and prioritizing design before execution.
